title: helictotrichon gervaisii subsp. arundanum
intro: Helictotrichon gervaisii subsp. arundanum, commonly known as Arundan False Brome, is a type of ornamental grass native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been reported to have health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Helictotrichon gervaisii subsp. arundanum have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant.
